_doc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. Reinterpretation-only framework chrome (structural labels + window titles). Content lives in each data/provotypes/*.json; this file is only the shell the runtime draws around it. Read behind ?reinterp=1 only. launcherIconIntake added Session R4 — a second, distinguishable desktop icon so both provotypes coexist on the one Era-1 desktop that exists in code today (both remain reachable for review/testing; not a statement about final placement, which data/paths.json composes later). movementHint added Session R28-1 (the movement prototype, src/engine/app.ts) — the ONE non-diegetic instruction line shown once per page load, the first time a click-to-move marker becomes available; frame voice, plain, no charm (this is chrome, not the conductor). floppyHint added Session 27 (R28-0c, item 10, Sérgio: 'guide the player to the floppy — it's a guided experience') — a small dismissable status line shown while the desktop is up and the kit floppy hasn't been inserted yet, alongside a subtle STATIC brightness/emissive lift on the physical floppy prop itself (src/engine/app.ts); both retire the instant the disk goes in (os.kit becomes truthy). Frame voice, not a diegetic system line — same register as movementHint.
floppyHint: Insert the floppy disk on the desk to begin.
